errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Only MoHD FFN' line starts at approximately 11.6. However, the plot shows this line starting clearly below the horizontal 'Transformer' line (which is at ~11.6), at a value of approximately 11.4.
The description states the 'Only MoHD FFN' line decreases to 11.4 at 50%, but the plot shows the value is lower, at approximately 11.3.
The description identifies the markers for the 'Only MoHD ATTN' line as diamonds, but they are clearly circles in the plot.
The description states the 'Only MoHD ATTN' line starts at 11.6, but the plot shows it starting at approximately 11.4.
The description claims the 'Only MoHD ATTN' line remains steady until the x-value of 50. The plot shows a clear increase from approximately 11.4 at 100% to 12.2 at 50%.
The description states the 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' line starts at 11.6, but the plot shows it starting at approximately 11.4.
The description claims the 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' line remains steady until the x-value of 50. The plot shows a clear increase from approximately 11.4 at 100% to 12.05 at 50%.
